story:
Ethan had been building the most incredible red truck out of cardboard boxes while his little sister Maya watched from the doorway. The truck was three boxes tall, with round yellow wheels and a chunky driver's seat inside.

[emotion:QT/surprised] "That is the best thing I have ever seen," Maya said, her eyes wide.

Before Ethan could finish painting the roof, Maya tripped and crashed right into it. Pieces flew everywhere.

[emotion:QT/sad] Ethan felt a sharp sting in his chest, but then he saw Maya's trembling chin and thought, *she probably feels terrible right now.*

"I think we should rebuild it together," Ethan said, although it wasn't easy to say.

Maya grabbed the tape while Ethan held the tall side steady. They worked carefully, taking turns choosing where each piece went. After that, the truck looked even more impressive than before. [emotion:QT/happy] "Three wheels, four wheels — we made it better," Maya said, laughing. [emotion:QT/happy] Ethan thought that was exactly right. [emotion:QT/calm]

questions.question: What is the main message of this story about Ethan and his truck?
questions.correct_answer: Working together can make things even better than before
wrong_answers: Building trucks out of cardboard is really tricky
Younger sisters should not touch things that are not theirs

questions.question: What was Ethan's red truck made from, and where was Maya standing while he was building it?
questions.correct_answer: Cardboard boxes, and Maya was standing in the doorway
wrong_answers: Wooden blocks, and Maya was sitting on the floor
Cardboard boxes, and Maya was watching from the garden

questions.question: After the truck crashed into pieces, what did Ethan and Maya each do to rebuild it together?
questions.correct_answer: Maya grabbed the tape while Ethan held the tall side steady
wrong_answers: Ethan got the tape while Maya painted the roof red
They both chose three new boxes and started over from scratch

questions.question: Why do you think it was not easy for Ethan to say they should rebuild the truck together?
questions.correct_answer: Because he felt really sad that his truck was wrecked
wrong_answers: Because he thought the truck was already finished
Because he did not think Maya was a good helper

questions.question: What do you think would have happened if Ethan had not thought about how Maya was feeling after she crashed into the truck?
questions.correct_answer: He might have gotten angry and they would not have rebuilt it together
wrong_answers: Maya would have cheerfully rebuilt the whole truck by herself
The truck would have three wheels instead of four

questions.question: Why was it a good idea for Ethan to rebuild the truck with Maya instead of doing it alone?
questions.correct_answer: Asking for help and working together often makes things turn out even better.
wrong_answers: Letting someone else do the hard work means you can rest and enjoy the result.
Sharing your supplies with others is the best way to finish a project quickly.

questions.question: What did Ethan show us by what he did when he noticed Maya's trembling chin?
questions.correct_answer: Thinking about how someone else feels helps you make a kind choice.
wrong_answers: Staying calm in a difficult moment means you should walk away and take a break.
Noticing when someone is upset means you should find a grown-up to help right away.

questions.question: What is one lesson from this story about how Ethan treated his little sister?
questions.correct_answer: Being patient with someone you love makes your relationship stronger.
wrong_answers: Forgiving someone right away means you should forget what happened and move on.
Letting a younger sibling join your activities always leads to things getting broken.

takeaways: Asking for help and working together often makes things turn out even better.
Thinking about how someone else feels helps you make a kind choice.
Being patient with someone you love makes your relationship stronger.
